## Download

| File | Recommended for |
|---|---|
| `RDPExtender.exe` | Most users. Standard 64-bit Windows PCs. |
| `RDPExtender-x86.exe` | Older 32-bit Windows PCs. |
| `RDPExtender-arm64.exe` | ARM-based Windows PCs, such as Surface Pro X and Copilot+ PCs. |
| `RDPExtender-CLI.exe` | Command-line tool for sysadmins, automation, and scripts. 64-bit only. |

> Not sure which one to download?
> Press **Win + Pause/Break** and check **System type**.
> If it says **x64**, download `RDPExtender.exe`.
